D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLOR IA EXER CITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, possibly Trier mint 333-334, possibly RIC vol. 7 page 218 no. 556, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them, a stalk or branch vertical between standards. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXER CITVS. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 2.01gms, die axis: 6
